page.notes: The first line of the printed page is set in roman type and the paragraph opening is continued from the previous page. The word after "Deo," is partly obscured and is read as "ut" with doubt. The word "plenum" is printed with a doubtful letter that may be n. The last line is cut off at the foot of this part, so "perso-" is incomplete. A small ornament or mark stands between "Iudai" and "Graeci"; I have written it as {*} and it may be a printer's ornament rather than a reference mark. The left edge carries fragments of the neighbouring text, which are not transcribed. The word at the very start of the first line is cut off at the scan edge and is given only as far as it is visible.
